items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: Well, where's Pops Monster? New York. Been there a long time.

ctx.x: I didn't think he was a pretend fellow.
Well, where's Pops Monster? New York. Been there a long time. Now, where is he from originally? Right here.
Oh, I see. Well, right uptown. Well, did he work with uptown bands or downtown?
